title: Consistent dreams about ‘Mall world’
content: Wow I can’t believe this reddit group just popped up, I’m in disbelief that I was not alone and this in some sort of phenomena so I’ll just post my experience Now for some reference I’ve always had strong dream recollection, usually a few dreams per night, varying in how vivid As a child, probably between the ages of 8-13, every so often In dreams I would find a screen, be it tv or computer monitor, and if I did I knew I would be able to enter the Mall world. The screens acted as some kind of portal Sometimes when I entered I would have friends there, sometimes waiting as if they knew I would arrive, sometimes it was a coincidence like I’d just rocked up at the right time, usually in different settings - for example once they were were standing around a parked car next to the ocean at sunset and then we went further into the mall - (Not always the same friends, none of who I knew as actual people in real life, and they were also adults/late teens which is odd considering how young I was). Other times I would go into the mall world and would be almost alone besides strangers walking passed and then I’d run into other people I knew or had met there before For a long time the screens that I would find were in my neighbours house, this neighbour was a grumpy old bastard, so in the dreams I would always have to sneak in somehow because I’d want to find a portal to go to the mall world. One day in a dream I’d dreamt that neighbours house had burned down, and I searched through the charred remains of the house for any signs a screen was still there so I could see my friends, I searched the whole house and found a room in the back with a partially burnt Tv that was still intact and the portal worked I have had many many experiences that would be too long to do into detail of the things I experienced in this realm, I always thought they were just bizarre fun dreams. This reddit page has really spun me out
